name: Caliphear
description: A nightmare ridden by Altair that teaches Jared about black mana.

description_citations.text: "Wayfarer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jamil summons Caliphear and she kills his brother Nevar; she is then unsummoned and returns home to Golthonor.
timeline.quote: the wizard Nevar quickly falls before the might of the dark steed.

citation.text: "Nightmare (comic)", section "Prelude". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Caliphear finds her swamp dying and defeats an Azure Drake chasing Laconia; Laconia explains the raid and the draining enchantment.
timeline.quote: Since she is on her own ground, Caliphear easily defeats the Drake.

citation.text: "Nightmare (comic)", section "Meeting Altair". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Corthipan Inlet Caliphear finds the Torrent blocked and meets Altair, whose enchantment redirects her magic; they ally for ten years of his service.
timeline.quote: In exchange for her help, Altair offers her ten years of service. Caliphear accepts.

citation.text: "Nightmare (comic)", section "Meeting Altair". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Caliphear tortures a captive Devouring Deep until Altair stops her; it reveals it serves Coldraith.
timeline.quote: The Devouring Deep confesses to serve the wizard Coldraith of Golthonor .

citation.text: "Nightmare (comic)", section "Battling Coldraith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Coldraith's Keep Caliphear catapults Altair over the wall; Altair destroys the Wall of Brambles with Swords to Plowshares and the Healer's army fights the Brass Men.
timeline.quote: In order to get over the wall, Caliphear catapults Altair over the wall.

citation.text: "Nightmare (comic)", section "Battling Coldraith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Coldraith casts Tranquility, freeing Altair from his bindings and revealing him as a mighty Planeswalker; Caliphear kills the vulnerable Coldraith.
timeline.quote: he is revealed to be a mighty Planeswalker.

citation.text: "Nightmare (comic)", section "Battling Coldraith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Coldraith dead his spells break and the Torrent flows again; Altair confirms he will serve Caliphear for ten years.
timeline.quote: Altair remembers his promise and confirms his intention to be her servant for ten years.

citation.text: "Nightmare (comic)", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi refuses Leshrac's recruitment and sends Caliphear to warn Freyalise.
timeline.quote: Leshrac then steals some artifacts and spells from the island, ensuring that his visit is not a waste of time.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian gremlins grab the Mox Beacon and haul it to Phyrexia to destroy it after Taysir opens a door to the Hell of Artifice.
timeline.quote: Numerous Phyrexian gremlin rush out and grab the Beacon, then haul it over to Phyrexia to destroy it.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi's Force of Nature trap and the Chime's chaos make the earth collapse and swallow Ravidel.
timeline.quote: The earth around Ravidel collapses, and he falls.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: confirms his intention to be her servant for ten years.

citation.text: "Nightmare (comic)", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
